purpose: Factual evidence development comparison; never legally validated tax accuracy
default: Run deterministic baseline; record both model methods NOT_RUN with zero provider calls
simulated_direct: Constant INSUFFICIENT_TO_ESTABLISH_CONTROL response for every case; does not read labels, is not a model, and is only an accounting/demo stub
simulated_hybrid: Replay frozen Phase 3 hand-authored extraction fixtures; not model outputs
freeze: Validate and hash dataset, labels, exact evidence anchors, protocol, prompts and implementation before any prediction; exclusive output directory; verify hashes afterwards
independence: All supplied synthetic sets are visible development data; no independent holdout or practitioner validation is claimed
agreement: Status matches among successful labelled cases, plus separate successful matches over all planned labelled cases and completion coverage
incorrect_confidence: Successful directional customer/vendor prediction unequal to provisional expected status; unexecuted/error cases excluded and counted separately
false_negative: Successful case with directional expected status but a different observed status; overlaps false positives for opposite-direction mistakes; can include justified abstention
abstention: Successful insufficient/conflicting factual outcome; OUT_OF_SCOPE counted separately; execution failures are not successful abstentions
provenance: Recheck each structured submitted quote as an exact substring of input contract; provenance is not interpretation correctness
unsupported_interpretation: Exact quotes rejected/unverified by the recorded factual support checks; this measures validator disposition, not independently annotated semantic truth
latency: Pipeline runtime in seconds for executed rows only; historical values remain historical; no latency inferred for missing rows
usage_and_cost: Sum only explicitly reported nonnegative usage/cost, with reported/attempted denominators; absence is not zero; simulations labelled and never treated as real spending
future_live_comparison: Separate authorization required. Use one explicitly allowlisted fixed free model for both methods, same frozen cases/prompts, one request per case/method, at least 15 second pacing, stop both methods on any provider block, no retry/model switching/paid fallback; preserve every attempt and missing row
current_runner_live_requests: None: this CLI cannot enable network inference. It can import hash-pinned recorded reports, preserving their claimed execution origin and model IDs without treating files as authenticated provider attestations.
